facts.text: Parker, that dessert better be worth the money. I am not paying for a blurry photo of a cake.
facts.why: Set out as the character's own words, but the film does not have them say it. Jameson's real lines in the film include 'Doesn't anybody care about what I want?' (said when Eddie and Peter both want the staff job).
facts.fix: Parker, the dessert photo had better be sharp. I pay by the print, not by the pie.

facts.text: Serve dessert when Peter takes MJ to the fancy French restaurant to propose.
facts.why: The sources opened confirm Peter plans to propose, Aunt May gives him her ring, and Bruce Campbell plays a French maitre d' who helps him. None of them place dessert in the scene, so the exact timing is unconfirmed.
facts.fix: Serve dessert when Peter and MJ sit down at the fancy French restaurant and he tries to propose.

vibe.verdict: Right newsroom and the main plot beats are there, but it skips the black suit strut and Venom, and the food jokes are soft.
missing: Bad Peter's street strut in the black suit (after the symbiote takes over)
Jameson's 'You're fired!' to Eddie Brock over the faked photo (Daily Bugle)
Eddie Brock praying in the church before the bell tower scene
Harry's pumpkin bomb and the New Goblin glider fight
Sandman reforming from sand and the locket for his daughter
Bruce Campbell's maitre d' stealing the proposal dinner
ideas: Swap 'Cream soda over ice' for a 'Venom black sludge shake' (chocolate, licorice, black sesame) tied to the church bell tower.
Rename 'Harry and MJ's omelette bites' to 'Pumpkin bomb arancini' and put Harry's glider fight in the note.
Swap 'Jazz club fig and goat's cheese bites' note for 'Bad Peter's strut, then the bouncers' so the famous strut gets a nod.
Add a maitre d' line to the crème brûlée note: 'The waiter steals the proposal.'
